Misc. File No. 43/39.
Hongkew Station,
REPORT
Date Feb. 18th, 1939.
Subject Further to:- Two male Russians and two male Chinese taken into
custody of the Japanese Consular Police in connection with a godown
breaking case.
Made by J.D.S.137 K.Suga Forwarded by
Sir,
On the morning of 18/2/39, the undersigned proceeded to the
Japanese Consular Police Station, when it was ascertained that
the arrested two male Russians, namely (1) V.K.Dombrovo, residing
at 125/17 Route De Groushy, F.C., (2) K.M.Strieff, residing at
51/3 Room 21, Route De Groushy, F.C., and two male Chinese, namely
(1) Li An Yuen(李杏園 ), (2) Sung ei Lung(孫梅壽 ), had
been released immediately after they had been taken to the Japanese
Consulate and after a breif interrogation regarding the transport-
ation and receiving of 22 bags of stolen sugar, which the Russians
and Chinese admitted.
Following has been revealed to be the fact of the case for
which the above named persons taken to the Japanese Consulate.
On diverse dates and during the day time between 17/1/39 and
24/1/39, a gang of Chinese thieves broken into a Japanese Godown
situated at No.102 Haining Road, owned by a Mr.Sadawo Kashima of
No.149 Range Road, and stole 79 bags of sugar to the value of
$2,528.00. At about 2 p.m. 27/1/39, the same gang broken into
a godown at No.32 Tsoongming Road, owned by a Mr.Animaco Fujita
of No.356 Woosung Road, and stole 52 cases of candle, value
$260.00, 19 bags of sugar, value $684.00, 10 cases of Japanese sake
value $250.00, 20 cases of cube-sugar, value $120.00, 4 cases of
biscuit, vlaue $32.00, 25 cases of whisky, value $500.00 and various
kinds of foodstuffs to the value of $500.00.
At about 11 a.m. 9/2/39, the same gang broken into the same
godown and stole 22 bags of sugar to the value of $770.00, which
stolen goods the above named Russians transported in their truck
and the Chinese received same.
During the night of 4/2/39 and 6/2/39, the same gang broken

日期：1939年2月18日。
事由：续报：两名俄国男子和两名中国男子因涉及一起仓库盗窃案被日本领事警察拘留。
呈报人：J.D.S.137 K.Suga 转呈人
敬启者，
1939年2月18日上午，卑职前往日本领事警察署，经查明，被捕的两名俄国男子，即(1) V.K.Dombrovo，住法租界格罗希路（Route De Groushy）125/17号，(2) K.M.Strieff，住法租界格罗希路（Route De Groushy）51/3号21室，以及两名中国男子，即(1) 李杏園 (Li An Yuen)，(2) 孫梅壽 (Sung ei Lung)，在被带至日本领事馆并就运输和接收22袋被盗白糖一事进行简短讯问后——俄国人及中国人均承认了上述行为——随即获释。
经查，上述人员被带往日本领事馆所涉案件的事实如下：
在1939年1月17日至1月24日期间不同的日期及白天时段，一伙中国窃贼闯入位于海宁路102号的一座日本仓库，该仓库由朗格路（Range Road）149号的 Sadawo Kashima 先生所有，窃得79袋白糖，价值2,528.00美元。1939年1月27日下午2时许，同一伙窃贼闯入崇明路32号的一座仓库，该仓库由吴淞路356号的 Animaco Fujita 先生所有，窃得蜡烛52箱，价值260.00美元；白糖19袋，价值684.00美元；日本清酒10箱，价值250.00美元；方糖20箱，价值120.00美元；饼干4箱，价值32.00美元；威士忌25箱，价值500.00美元；以及各种食品，价值500.00美元。
1939年2月9日上午11时许，同一伙窃贼再次闯入同一座仓库，窃得白糖22袋，价值770.00美元。上述俄国人用卡车运输了这些赃物，并由上述中国人接收。

位于天潼路154-6号的一座仓库，该仓库由宁宏路242号的 T.Hatsji Hirewo 所有，窃得大米10袋，价值72.00美元；日本清酒38箱，价值630.00美元；以及啤酒15箱，价值72.00美元。

在上述案件中，6名日本收赃者目前正由日本领事警察拘留并接受讯问。

上述被带往领事警察署的中国人在被讯问时据称承认，禄寿路（Loosung Rd）121-3号的店主 Kyu Yung Fong(□ □ □) 也随同窃贼团伙参与了上述仓库盗窃案的作案现场行动。

据报道，上述团伙的头目为一名叫徐小头 (Soo Siau Tou) 的男子，住江西北路德盛里东58号；以及一名叫 Sz Fah Tae(□ □ □) 的男子，住江西北路德盛里西8号。此二人目前在逃。

就上述盗窃案而言，领事警察逮捕了6名中国男子，并将他们移交给日本宪兵队以作进一步调查。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Hongkew Station.
REPORT
Date Feb. 17th, 1939.

Subject. Two male Russians and two male Chinese taken into custody of the
Japanese Consular Police in connection with a godown-breaking case.
Made by. J.D.S.137, K.Ouza Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,
At 2.30 p.m. 17/2/39, C.P.C.50 on point duty at Woosung and
Tien-dong Roads corner reported to the Charge Room that at about
2 p.m. even date, he had seen two male Russians and two male
Chinese arrested and taken away in a M/car, Lic.number of which
unknown, by a party of civilian clothes Japanese from a Chinese
shop on Woosung Road near Tiendong Road.
Enquiries were made by C.D.C.222 and the undersigned and
the following has been ascertained.
Place where the above occurrence took place was found to be
a Chinese candle shop, "Lou Jiang Tai and Yah Tai", by shop-name,
at No.121-123 Woosung Road.
A male Chinese named Sung Bai Ching(宋百慶), 45, Tsu-
shing, who was found in the above shop, when questioned by the
detectives stated that at about 2 p.m. today, a party of Japanese
Consular Police in civilian clothes came to his shop and arrested
two of the Chinese shop-assistants, namely (1) Li An Yuen(李安元),
(2) Sung Mei Sung(宋梅嵩), and two male Russians, name, etc.,
unknown, who were then in the shop, and taken away in a waiting
M/car.
Further questioned as to why they had to be arrested, the
above Chinese stated that he did not know exactly, but that he
believed that the two Russians had attempted or sold some 22
bags of sugar to the arrested Chinese, which sugar was said to
have been stolen.
The Japanese Consular Police authorities were immediately
approached by the undersigned on this matter, when they stated
they were making enquiries into a godown breaking case in which
Russians were involved and big quantity of sugar stolen.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

报告
日期：1939年2月17日。

事由：两名俄国男子和两名中国男子因涉及一起仓库盗窃案被日本领事警察拘留。
呈报人：J.D.S.137, K.Ouza 转呈人 [签名]

敬启者，
1939年2月17日下午2时30分，在吴淞路与天潼路拐角处执行定点巡逻任务的警员 C.P.C.50 向值班室报告称，当日下午2时许，他目睹两名俄国男子和两名中国男子被一群身着便服的日本人从吴淞路近天潼路的一家中国商店逮捕，并带上一辆汽车带走，该车牌照号码不详。
经警员 C.D.C.222 及卑职调查，查明情况如下。
上述事件发生地点经查为吴淞路121-123号的一家中国蜡烛店，店名为“娄江泰和亚泰”（音译，Lou Jiang Tai and Yah Tai）。
在该店内发现的一名中国男子宋百慶 (Sung Bai Ching)，45岁，祖籍祝圣（音译，Tsu-shing），在接受侦探讯问时陈述，今日下午2时许，一群身着便服的日本领事警察来到其店内，逮捕了两名中国店员，即(1) 李安元 (Li An Yuen)，(2) 宋梅嵩 (Sung Mei Sung)，以及当时在店内的两名俄国男子，姓名等信息不详，随后将他们带上一辆等候的汽车离开。
当被进一步问及逮捕原因时，上述中国人表示并不确切知晓，但他相信是因为这两名俄国人试图向被捕的中国人出售或已出售约22袋白糖，据说这些白糖是被盗之物。
卑职随即就此事项联系日本领事警察当局，对方表示他们正在调查一起涉及俄国人及大量白糖被盗的仓库盗窃案。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处）
